title: One project's entry in the runner's registry, /home/jorah/.config/jorah-projects/projects.json, keyed by the project's name

repo.description: owner/name on GitHub, or null for a local-only project with no GitHub repo yet; its workDir is then a local git repo the runner creates

workDir.description: Absolute path of the working clone, with no . or .. parts. The runner also checks it is under its work root

branch.description: The work line; always under jorah/, the only branches the GitHub App may write

stateDir.description: The project folder, relative to the repo root, never inside .git. project when left out

level.description: Trust level: 0 supervised, 1 scheduled, 2 standing grant (plan section 6)

schedule.description: Times of day, in the PC's local time zone, when a run is due. Empty means run-now requests only

web.description: WebSearch and WebFetch in runs. false when left out

bench.description: The bench environment for runs, or null. null when left out
